title: From Karnataka's kitchens to your table
lead: KokoFresh began with a simple frustration: the masala on the shelf never smelled like the masala at home.

sections.heading: Ground after you order
sections.body:
Most spice powders are milled months before they reach you, then sit in a warehouse losing the aromatic oils that made them worth buying. We grind each blend only after your order is placed, in small batches, and pack it the same day.

It is slower. It is also the entire point.

sections.heading: Whole spices, nothing else
sections.body: Commercial powders are often bulked out with roasted lentils, rice flour or extra chilli to increase volume. We use whole spices sourced directly from farms — no fillers, no anti-caking agents, no preservatives, no colour.

sections.heading: Crafted by women artisans
sections.body: Every blend is roasted and stone-ground by skilled women artisans who have been making these recipes their whole lives. Stone grinding keeps the temperature low, which protects the natural oils that carry the aroma.

sections.heading: Karnataka, specifically
sections.body: Our recipes are regional, not generic. A Mysore rasam powder is pepper-forward. A Melkote puliyogare powder follows the temple recipe. Byadagi chillies for colour, Malnad pepper from the Western Ghats.

values.title: Made to order
values.body: Ground and packed after you buy, never before.

values.title: No fillers
values.body: Whole spices only. Nothing added to bulk it out.
